::: {.home-section}
## How the work flows

```{=html}
<ol class="flow">
  <li><strong>Field problem</strong><span>Find who struggles with what, from press, surveys and cases</span></li>
  <li><strong>Market research</strong><span>Split the problems into stages and rank them</span></li>
  <li><strong>Data search</strong><span>Rate public data on access, completeness and one-person feasibility</span></li>
  <li><strong>Analysis and checks</strong><span>Fix criteria before results; confirm on another period</span></li>
  <li><strong>Use and limits</strong><span>Separate what can be done from what cannot</span></li>
</ol>
```
:::

::: {.home-section}
## How I work

::: {.principle}
Find the action with the least resistance that can still be carried out within the constraints.
:::

* Check first whether the data can actually be obtained.
* Fix decision rules before seeing results.
* Choose a proven simple method unless there is evidence a complex one is better.
* Report unfavorable results and limits as they are.
:::
